description: Panneaux indicateurs de signalisation routière et piétonne - Données géographiques is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Paris. Vector-type data describing road and pedestrian signs: signposts, pedestrian post, signposts. Coverage: Ville de Paris. The portal shows the English title as "Traffic and pedestrian signs - Geographical data" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Paris. Its keywords include pieton, route, signalisation, panneau, voirie. The listing shows 2014-11-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
